blocks.x: Okay, we have a number of things

that we could refer to. Ernie, now here's a billing--here is one, we'll go first, the Pittsburgh Courier, May 10, 1952 in which you had a tremendous write-up, Ernie Fields big crew moves up (inaudible). What year was that?
I don't remember exactly but when that ended I was around--

That was 1952; Duke and Basie were the only bands over you, I think. Here's one where you scored on a Pacific coast tour. This was October 1952 in the Courier, here you are along with Hamp and all the big names. Zutty Singleton is in this too.
These will be priceless, send these to Rutgers when you send him the tape.
